caption: Northvale Co-op members survey 2026: 72% of delivery users rated home delivery good or very good, up from 61% last year. 58% said they were likely or very likely to recommend us, down from 64% in 2025. Why satisfaction changed has not been analysed; open-text coding is due in September. Source: research team, 12 August 2026 (1,204 responses).
alt: An explainer video in one continuous world: a field of 1,204 dots for the members who answered, a pallet of parcels by a house, one parcel per percent of delivery users, where 72% light up for delivery users rating it good, a plinth for the verdict, the field again for 64% falling to 58%, and a desk of answers waiting to be coded by September.
